profiles.summary: General production profile with policy-bound Repair and operator-oriented controls.

selection_rules: Profile signatures prove provenance; the deployment parent fingerprint proves exact selection.
Production selection verifies packaged signatures under the protected role.
Use independent trusted fingerprints when initial trust must not rely on embedded convenience values.
